holderPosition.says: Theo markets thBILL as exposure to tokenized Treasury funds (ULTRA, and on one part of its page also FILQ), and Libeara calls it indirect exposure to the ULTRA strategy. No holder agreement names an obligor, a secured claim or a redemption debt, and a holder has no established route to ULTRA or FILQ. The proposed claim kind is left empty because the sources do not establish which one applies.

verdict.summary: The restatement can show only Theo's two inconsistent token declarations and a flag between them; every statement beneath them is unnamed. The core of what a holder has, a claim against an unidentified Theo entity over wrapped units of a fund, cannot be said, because v3 has no claim kind for it and no way to chain a wrapper to the fund units it holds. The evidence fails first: no holder terms, deployment or custodian were found.
